title: Marine & Family Support
intro: Enhancing the quality of life for service members and their families through a wide range of resources

sections.heading: Child and Youth
sections.markdown:
Child and Youth Programs (CYP) provides affordable, high-quality childcare to children 6 weeks to 12 years of age. Our goal is to provide a safe and nurturing environment that promotes the physical, social, emotional, cognitive, and language development of children enrolled in the programs

* [New Parent Support](/marine-family-support/child-and-youth/new-parent-support)
* [Child Development Centers](/marine-family-support/child-and-youth/child-development-centers)
* [Family Child Care](/marine-family-support/child-and-youth/family-child-care)
* [School Age Care](/marine-family-support/child-and-youth/school-age-care)
* [School Liaison](/marine-family-support/child-and-youth/school-liaison)
* [Youth Programs](https://quantico.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/child-and-youth)
* [Exceptional Family Member Program](/marine-family-support/military-family-life/exceptional-family-member-program/)
* [Youth Sports](/recreation-fitness/sports/youth-sports/)

sections.heading: Information, Referral, and Relocation
sections.markdown: We connect service members and their families to valuable resources, helping them successfully navigate their military journey.

sections.heading: Libraries
sections.markdown: We enrich the lives of our military community by fostering opportunities for connection and providing equitable access to knowledge, innovation, and creativity.

sections.heading: Military Family Life
sections.markdown:
Programs and services that work with Marines and their families to address deployment, return and reunion issues as well as other stressors that impact a Marine's daily life.

* [Exceptional Family Member Program](/marine-family-support/military-family-life/exceptional-family-member-program)
* [Family Advocacy Program](/marine-family-support/military-family-life/family-advocacy-program)
* [Marine Corps Family Team Building](/marine-family-support/military-family-life/marine-corps-family-team-building)
* [Family Member Employment Assistance Program](/marine-family-support/military-family-life/family-member-employment-assistance-program)
* [Voting Assistance](/marine-family-support/military-family-life/voting-assistance)

sections.heading: Personal Financial Management
sections.markdown: We provide you and your family with professional training and guidance to help you manage money successfully.

sections.heading: Prevention and Counseling
sections.markdown:
Assisting Marines and families in accomplishing their personal goals through short-term solution focused counseling, skill enhancement, education and referrals to other helping resources.

* [Sexual Assault Prevention and Response](/marine-family-support/prevention-and-counseling/sexual-assault-prevention-and-response)
* [Substance Misuse](/marine-family-support/prevention-and-counseling/substance-misuse)
* [Suicide Prevention](/marine-family-support/prevention-and-counseling/suicide-prevention)
* [Family Advocacy Program](/marine-family-support/military-family-life/family-advocacy-program)
* [Victim Advocacy Program](/marine-family-support/prevention-and-counseling/victim-advocacy-program)
* [Semper Support](/marine-family-support/prevention-and-counseling/semper-support)
* [New Parent Support](/marine-family-support/child-and-youth/new-parent-support/)
* [Community Counseling](/marine-family-support/prevention-and-counseling/community-counseling)
* [Domestic Abuse](/marine-family-support/prevention-and-counseling/domestic-abuse)
* [Military OneSource](/marine-family-support/prevention-and-counseling/military-onesource)

sections.heading: Single Marine Program
sections.markdown: The Single Marine Program (SMP) serves as the voice for single Marines in identifying concerns, developing initiatives, and providing recommendations through advocacy, recreational activities, special events and community involvement. The SMP is comprised of single Marines who represent their Unit and want to make a difference within their unit and on their installation.

sections.heading: Transition Readiness Program
sections.markdown:
We prepare Marines for the civilian workforce through the Transition Readiness Program by providing guidance and training for transitioning success.

* [Marine For Life Network](/marine-family-support/transition-readiness-program/marine-for-life-network)
* [SkillBridge](/marine-family-support/transition-readiness-program/skillbridge)

sections.heading: Voluntary Education
sections.markdown: We provide professional guidance, tools, and support to help you successfully reach your education and career goals.

sections.heading: Volunteer Opportunities
sections.markdown: Connecting you with meaningful volunteering opportunities that strengthen the military community and enhance the well-being of Marines and their families.
